newsitem.title: NORWAY: Gullfaks ready to restart output - Statoil.
newsitem.headline: Gullfaks ready to restart output - Statoil.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) will begin restarting oil production at the North Sea Gullfaks development later on Thursday after a 14-day maintenance shutdown, a company spokesman said.
Gullfaks A, B and C platforms together with Saga Petroleum's Tordis development, which feeds through crude to Gullfaks C for processing, were shut in for scheduled turnaround on October 11.

Statoil spokesman Odd Jan Lange said production would resume at the 148,000 barrel per day (bpd) Gullfaks A platform later on Thursday, while the 104,000 bpd B installation would be brought on stream in the early hours of Friday.
Gullfaks C, which produces an average 194,000 bpd, would start up one day behind schedule on October 27 due to increased work during the maintenance, Lange said.
A spokesman for Saga Petroleum said the 80,000 bpd Tordis field would resume pumping on the same day as Gullfaks C.
